extracted.name: Crockpot Garlic Butter Chicken and Veggies
extracted.description: Just a wonderful meal idea a friend told me about but I tweaked it a little bit to make it my own 🥰
ingredient_lines: 2-3 Lg. Chicken breasts, boneless and skinless cut into strips
instruction_lines: In a small saucepan add the butter and seasonings and minced garlic. Cook on low til butter is melted and set aside.
Add chicken to crockpot then then the rest of ingredients. Pour the butter sauce over everything. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or on low for 8 hours.
Serve immediately. I serve with Flaky Butter Biscuits and a side salad. Enjoy 😊
